mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor markets boost corporate profits and consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strengthening economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.5% annualized, it signals strong economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) indicate a monetary tightening cycle that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), strong housing activity fuels consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
